purpose: Explain a proposal to add written transcripts to a fictional museum's audio guides
audience: Visitors deciding how to use the museum guide on their phones
reader_knowledge: They know there are audio guides but have not seen the transcript option
core_point: Adding a clearly labelled transcript button may make the guides easier to use for visitors who prefer reading
writer_stance: This is a design proposal, not a proven accessibility improvement
known_facts: In this fictional scenario, exhibit pages currently provide audio descriptions only.
The proposed prototype adds a Transcript button that displays the same scripted description as readable text.
No visitor testing or accessibility audit has yet been conducted.
unknowns: The effect on visitor understanding and satisfaction is unknown.
The accuracy of captions for any unscripted audio is outside this prototype.
required_details: Explain what changes for a visitor.
Describe a possible benefit without claiming observed outcomes.
